mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_order (order_no, shop_id, sku_id, sku_name, quantity, total_price, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, buyer_username, shop_name, sku_image, shop_phone, unit_price) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{shopId}, #{skuId}, #{skuName}, #{quantity}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{buyerUsername}, #{shopName}, #{skuImage}, #{shopPhone}, #{unitPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, shop_id, sku_id, sku_name, quantity, total_price, status, pay_type, pay_time, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, buyer_username, buyer_deleted, buyer_fav, shop_phone, shop_name, sku_image, unit_price, logistics_no, logistics_type, create_time, update_time FROM tb_order WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_refund WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_order SET status = #{status}, logistics_no = #{logisticsNo}, logistics_type = #{logisticsType}, update_time = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, shop_id, sku_id, sku_name, quantity, total_price, status, pay_type, pay_time, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, buyer_username, logistics_no, logistics_type, create_time, update_time FROM tb_order WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_username = #{buyerUsername} AND buyer_deleted = 0

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.shop_id, o.sku_id, o.sku_name, o.quantity, o.total_price, o.status, o.pay_type, o.order_type, o.order_category, o.logistics_type, o.logistics_no, o.store_name, o.shop_name, o.sku_image, o.unit_price, o.is_gift, o.buyer_deleted, o.buyer_username, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM tb_order o
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.shop_id, o.sku_id, o.sku_name, o.quantity, o.total_price, o.status, o.pay_type, o.order_type, o.order_category, o.logistics_type, o.logistics_no, o.store_name, o.shop_name, o.sku_image, o.unit_price, o.is_gift, o.buyer_deleted, o.buyer_fav, o.shop_phone, o.buyer_username, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM tb_order o
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_order WHERE buyer_username = #{buyerUsername} AND buyer_deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
